title: 36 Hours in San Diego
abstract: Whether you’re downing fish tacos and craft beers or getting your hair blown back by a roller coaster, you’ll find that San Diego delivers more than sunny vibes.

title: 36 Hours in Taipei, Taiwan
abstract: Shop and haggle, sip and snack, visit temples and touch the sky in a city that truly never sleeps.

title: 36 Hours in Cannes, France
abstract: You don’t need star status to have fun in this Riviera resort — just a few pairs of shoes to stroll by the water, hike on an island and glide across the dance floor.

title: 36 Hours in Salta, Argentina
abstract: This getaway tucked into the country’s northwest corner features everything from neo-Classical buildings to a tropical cloud forest to dishes made with tender llama meat.
